context: Evaluates: Scenario 05: Create an Implementation Plan for an E-commerce Checkout Redesign

checklist.name: plan-slug-is-kebab-case
checklist.description: The plan root directory slug is lowercase kebab-case

checklist.name: phase-slugs-are-kebab-case
checklist.description: All phase directory slugs are lowercase kebab-case and describe the phase outcome; no numeric-only slugs

checklist.name: task-identifier-format-all-files
checklist.description: Every task file uses the `P{NN}T{NN}` format with zero-padded 1-based numbers for both phase and task

checklist.name: task-numbering-starts-at-01
checklist.description: Task numbering starts at `T01` (not `T00`); phase numbering starts at `P01` (not `P00`)

checklist.name: task-numbering-sequential-no-gaps
checklist.description: Task numbers within each phase are sequential with no gaps

checklist.name: phase-numbering-sequential-no-gaps
checklist.description: Phase numbers are sequential with no gaps across the plan

checklist.name: no-spaces-or-underscores-in-slugs
checklist.description: No directory or file name contains spaces, underscores, or mixed case; all paths use hyphens

checklist.name: phase-and-task-zero-padding-two-digits
checklist.description: All phase and task numbers use two-digit zero-padding (01, 02, … 10, 11)

checklist.name: task-slug-after-identifier-is-descriptive
checklist.description: The slug portion of each task filename is descriptive and reflects the task content

checklist.name: root-readme-is-index
checklist.description: Root `README.md` links to phases but contains no task-level implementation detail

checklist.name: phase-readmes-include-goal-gate
checklist.description: Every phase `README.md` includes a goal statement and a concrete, runnable gate

checklist.name: validate-plan-run
checklist.description: Agent ran `validate-plan.sh <plan-slug>` after creating all files

checklist.name: completion-summary-includes-paths
checklist.description: Completion summary lists all file paths including directory-separated structure
